<!-- Generated by `pnpm --filter @cyberuni/gap-analysis run parameters`; edit tools/gap-analysis/data/parameter-coverage.json instead. -->

For each of the **171** Asana REST operations cyber-asana wraps, this page lists
every path, query, and top-level body parameter in the
[Asana OpenAPI definition](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Asana/openapi/master/defs/asana_oas.yaml) (fetched 2026-11-19) and how cyber-asana sends it.
Of **946** parameters, **838** are covered, **59** are skipped on purpose, and **49** are open gaps.
Header parameters are left out: an API client sets them once, not per command.

| Status | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| ✅ | Both the CLI and MCP send it |
| ➖ | Skipped on purpose, with the reason |
| ❌ | Not exposed yet; the linked issue tracks it |

Skipped on every operation:

- `opt_pretty`: Pretty-prints Asana's JSON; the CLI formats its own output and MCP serializes compactly

`pnpm --filter @cyberuni/gap-analysis test` fails when the committed API baseline has a parameter
this table does not classify, so refreshing the baseline after Asana adds one surfaces it here.

| `updateTimeTrackingEntry` | `description` | body | — | — | ❌ [#414](https://github.com/cyberuni/cyber-asana/issues/414) Neither CLI nor MCP sends it: TimeTrackingEntryFields carries only duration_minutes and entered_on (categories, billing and attribution are out of scope) |
